ufo's withBase(input, base) and withoutBase(input, base) in src/utils.ts (exported from src/index.ts) decide whether input already starts with base by a plain string prefix test, after dropping a trailing slash from base. So a path whose first segment merely begins with the base's text is taken as being under the base: today withoutBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin") returns "/-dashboard", withoutBase("/administrator", "/admin/") returns "/istrator", withBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin") returns "/admin-dashboard" unchanged as if the base were already there, and withBase("/apix", "/api") returns "/apix". Fix both functions so that the base counts as present only when it ends at a boundary of input: input equals the base (without its trailing slash), or the character right after it is "/" or "?". When it is not present, withBase joins the base in front of input as it does for any other path (withBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin") is "/admin/admin-dashboard", withBase("/a/bc", "/a/b/") is "/a/b/a/bc") and withoutBase returns input unchanged (withoutBase("/admin-dashboard", "/admin/") is "/admin-dashboard", withoutBase("/v10/items", "/v1") is "/v10/items"). What must not change: wherever the base does end at such a boundary, or input does not start with the base text at all, both functions return exactly what they return today, including a base followed by a query (withBase("/api?x=1", "/api") stays "/api?x=1", withoutBase("/api?test", "/api") stays "/?test"), a base equal to input (withoutBase("/base", "/base/") stays "/", withBase("/a/b", "/a/b") stays "/a/b"), nested paths (withoutBase("/admin/admin-dashboard", "/admin/") stays "/admin-dashboard"), an empty or "/" base, an input with a protocol given to withBase, and full URL bases (withoutBase("https://x.com/base/p", "https://x.com/base") stays "/p"); joinURL, withoutTrailingSlash, hasProtocol, isEmptyURL and every other export are unchanged. The tests are vitest files under test/, with these two functions in test/base.test.ts. Add regression tests for this behaviour to the project's existing test suite. The project's tests run with npx vitest run --typecheck (npm test runs pnpm lint first; on the unchanged base under this install, prettier already reports src/punycode.ts, so lint is not part of the required test command).
